title: DevSecOps Engineer
brief: Accepted the offer from CooperSurgical. Start working in January 2024.
introduction: Hey there, I kicked off my software journey back in 2017 and quickly found my groove in crafting high-volume tolerance systems and real-time applications. It's all about keeping things running smoothly, even when the going gets tough.

I'm your go-to person for all things DevSecOps – making sure your projects stay secure is my jam. Plus, I've got some experience leading teams and teaming up with folks from around the globe. Communication and teamwork are my secret sauce.
When I'm not knee-deep in code, I'm all about exploring the latest tech trends and sharing knowledge. Feel free to reach out, and we can discuss anything about technology, security, and software.
